name: RADT DAO wrapper unauthenticated withdraw
summary: The RADT-DAO token calls its wrapper's withdraw(from,to,amount) on every transfer and lets the wrapper move any holder's balance, but the wrapper never checks its caller. Calling it directly with the RADT/USDT pair as target paid the pair's RADT out to LP and fee addresses; the attacker then synced the pair and sold RADT into its USDT.
notes: The wrapper's pair-payout branch returns early while slot 0x1a is set. The owner set it at block 20646987 and cleared it (cc(false)) 36 blocks later, re-opening the path after the implementation upgrade (0x028d710c); that clear is the latest change the exploit needed.
Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion: the anchor's 95,305.58 out minus the attacker's 1,001 in, plus three small copycat drains on the emptied pair; the flash loan is repaid in-tx. USDT at par.
